subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Construction, teardown, layout, and rendering of generic runtime UI/rendering objects shared across menu screens: text widgets, scrollable list views, scrollbar areas, edit fields, and the deferred-cleanup destructor chain.

summary: Proposes eleven defensive classes for the generic runtime objects: TextWidget (init, word-wrap, cursor), DriverCareerStatsScreen, ScreenData, a DeferredCleanupObject destructor family (four teardown entry points), TimedAnimationController, ScrollbarRenderer, ScrollView plus its vtable dispatch slots, ScrollableListView (layout + clipped blit), a surface-region helper, and EditField. Owner classes are proposals only; most packet owners are UNKNOWN.

function_roles.role: Text widget initialization: sets text-source holder and margins, renders key aTtgjz, returns AIOvertakeGapCalc() (relation unresolved).
Menu text word-wrap measurer/backtracker; called by the four menu layout/cursor helpers.
Positions the menu cursor on wrapped text and renders the active menu item.
Rebuilds the driver career statistics UI screen: header labels plus seven career-data rows from a string-keyed linked list.
Utility clamp: clamps *a1 into [a2,a3] and returns the pre-clamp value.
ScreenData object constructor: zeroes struct, installs TextureManager vtable, seeds three (min,max) range sentinels.
Destructor: writes vtable, cleans sub-object at +224, chains base destructor, conditional free.
Teardown freeing three owned buffer pointers plus two sub-object cleanups.
Teardown freeing two owned buffer pointers plus two sub-object cleanups.
Advances a timed UI animation: accumulates progress, fires repeat/alpha-blend refresh on threshold.
Renders a scrollbar track/thumb rectangle via texture sub-rect blit or solid-fill fallback.
Renders a scrollable view with dirty-flag invalidation, scaled/non-scaled quad paths, and state-select surface blit.
Two-pass teardown (sub-object + base) with conditional free.
UI element render/position setup with dual child-vs-bounds path and finalization vtable dispatch.
Recalculates scrollable-list column/row counts, per-page count, and scroll span; clamps offsets.
Renders scrollable list area with viewport clipping, scrollbar, and per-item custom dispatch.
Filters input characters by edit-field type mode (1 = text, 2 = restricted).
Edit-text cursor reset / default-string reload, mode-flagged.

classes.name: TextWidget
classes.responsibility: Menu text widget: initialization, word-wrap measurement, and cursor positioning over a double-indirect text-source pointer.

classes.name: DriverCareerStatsScreen
classes.responsibility: Builds the driver career statistics menu screen by walking a career-data string-keyed linked list and rendering header labels and statistic rows.

classes.name: ScreenData
classes.responsibility: ScreenData construction: zeroes the large struct, installs the TextureManager vtable, clears a texture flag, and seeds three (min,max) range sentinels.

classes.name: DeferredCleanupObject
classes.responsibility: Destructor-chain teardown family: runs ConditionalDualCleanup on embedded sub-objects, chains the base destructor sub_485EB0, frees owned buffers, and frees self only when the a2 low bit is set.

classes.name: TimedAnimationController
classes.responsibility: Advances a timed UI animation: resolves a config block, accumulates progress, fires a repeat/alpha-blend refresh, and advances the frame index.

classes.name: ScrollbarRenderer
classes.responsibility: Renders a scrollbar track/thumb rectangle, substituting instance-default coordinates for the -50000 sentinel and choosing between texture sub-rect blit and solid-fill fallback.

classes.name: ScrollView
classes.responsibility: Renders a scrollable view: dirty-flag invalidation, scroll-mode texture-source selection, scaled/non-scaled quad rendering, and state-selected surface blit.

classes.name: ScrollViewVTableSlots
classes.responsibility: Vtable dispatch slot offsets consumed by the scroll-view renderers on the object referenced through this+0; each slot number is the byte offset divided by four.

classes.name: ScrollableListView
classes.responsibility: Scrollable list: layout recalculation (column/row counts, page size, scroll span) and viewport-clipped surface rendering with scrollbar.

classes.name: SurfaceRenderRegionHelper
classes.responsibility: UI element render/position setup with a dual path (structured child vs bounds fallback) writing the resulting rectangle to outputs.

classes.name: EditField
classes.responsibility: Edit-text control: input character filtering by field type mode and cursor reset / default-string reload.

state_machines.name: TimedAnimationAdvance
transitions: idle -> accumulating: config block resolved via ConditionalDelegation_6460 and frame count non-empty
accumulating -> triggered: progress accumulator exceeds block+0x18 threshold
triggered -> renderer_refresh: repeat count reaches zero, resolve UI string and set alpha blend
triggered -> accumulating: accumulator reset to 0 and frame index advanced

state_machines.name: ScrollViewRenderState
transitions: any -> early_out: state query sub_486830 returns 0 and alternate texture source not active (return -1)
state1 -> surface_blit: RenderSurfaceFillCopy blits computed region
state2_3 -> guarded_dispatch: DualDispatchWithGuard performs surface render

state_machines.name: EditFieldInputMode
transitions: field_type == 1 -> text_mode: blocks backslash, slash, colon, period, leading space
field_type == 2 -> restricted_mode: allows only sub_589B9E/sub_589B70-accepted characters plus period and colon
otherwise -> all_classified: all classified characters pass

interfaces.name: TextRenderInterface
interfaces.purpose: Renders text strings to surfaces and sets alpha-blend mode on resolved renderers.

interfaces.name: ConfigDelegationInterface
interfaces.purpose: Resolves configuration/child objects from a selector via ConditionalDelegation_6460.

interfaces.name: MemoryCleanupInterface
interfaces.purpose: Memory teardown primitives: base-destructor chain, dual sub-object cleanup, and conditional free.

interfaces.name: CareerDataAccessInterface
interfaces.purpose: Access to career data via indexed list and string-keyed linked-list lookups.

interfaces.name: MenuListConstructionInterface
interfaces.purpose: Builds UI menu item lists: insert nodes, index list, create items, and format/overwrite string buffers.

interfaces.name: RenderStateGlobalInterface
interfaces.purpose: Accesses the global render state/context object rooted at unk_7CDE00 (accessor, getter, and field-reader variants).

compatibility_contracts.name: TextWidgetFieldLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Text widget stores a double-indirect text-source pointer at +0xE0, a source object at +0xC8 (path string at +0x40), cursor index at +0xE4, width constraint at +0x100, and margin values at +0xF8/+0xFC.

compatibility_contracts.name: ScreenDataConstruction
compatibility_contracts.description: ScreenData constructor installs the TextureManager vtable 0x5A6E70, clears texture flag +0x210C, zeroes the texture-data region, and seeds three (min,max) = (0,-1) range pairs at +0x218C..+0x21A0.

compatibility_contracts.name: DestructorChainAndFreeFlag
compatibility_contracts.description: Teardown runs ConditionalDualCleanup on embedded sub-objects (e.g. +224/+288/+304), chains the base destructor sub_485EB0, and frees self only when the a2 low bit is set.

compatibility_contracts.name: CareerStatsScreenDataPath
compatibility_contracts.description: Driver career stats screen resolves the career-data root via the dword_7CD8C0 command interface vtable slot 7 with argument 17, indexes the result linked list, and renders seven rows keyed by nationality/dateofbirth/starts/poles/wins/driverschampio.

compatibility_contracts.name: ScrollableListViewLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Scrollable list stores boundary box at +0x4..+0x10, source object at +0xC8, column/row counts at +0x134/+0x138, scroll offset +0x14C, position +0x150, text width +0x158, content height +0x160, per-page count +0x164, and pixel span +0x16C.

compatibility_contracts.name: EditFieldCharFilter
compatibility_contracts.description: Edit field stores type at +0x2E8, buffer at +0x2F0, cursor at +0x2F4; type 1 blocks backslash/slash/colon/period/leading space, type 2 allows only classified characters plus period and colon.

compatibility_contracts.name: TimedAnimationConfigBlock
compatibility_contracts.description: Timed animation config block exposes a frame-count field at +0x10, a progress threshold at +0x18, and an advance mode at +0x1C (0 = clamp to frame count, 1 = wrap modulo).

compatibility_contracts.name: RenderStateGlobal
compatibility_contracts.description: unk_7CDE00 is the global render state/context object read by the scrollbar, scroll-view, and surface-region render paths through the accessor/getter/field-reader trio.

unresolved: TextWidget field this+0x108 is present in the packet field evidence but has no reference in the raw source of 0x0047AAB0 or 0x00489D00.
Global dword_8AD3B4 (0x008AD3B4) appears in the packet globals but has no reference in the raw decompiled source of 0x0047DD10.
AIOvertakeGapCalc is used as the return value of TextWidgetInit but is not listed among the packet callees; its relation to the text widget is unresolved.
The obj+0xA8 field of the child structure returned by the vtable+168 dispatch in Surface_Render_Region_Setup is not reachable from the shown raw source.
callers 0x0048B600 and 0x0048B810 of InputCharFilterByFieldType and field obj+0x0000002C in StringCursorReset have no visible reference in the decompiled source.
The scroll-mode guard in RenderScrollView is ambiguous: raw C reaches the compared value through this+64 plus offset 56, while the deterministic guard table attributes the == 2 test to this+0x78.

Class grouping (TextWidget, DeferredCleanupObject, ScrollView, ScrollableListView) is inferred from shared field semantics; equal byte offsets on different this objects are not proven common ownership.
The career-data anchor at (result + 0x3C), the node byte flag at node+8, and the vtable slot at byte offset 28 of the dword_7CD8C0 object have no packet field evidence refs.
Block-local offsets of the animation config and the scroll-item node layout (node+0/4/8/12 and next link) are not represented in the packet field table.
The -50000 sentinel semantics, the 65793 and 986895/11206570 constants, and the a3 fallback flag meanings are inferred and not named by the packet.
Semantics of vtable slots 28 and 36 dimension getters and the delegate-derived this+0x15C value in RecalculateListLayout are DERIVED from layout semantics, not directly evidenced.
The 0xFF wrap delimiter, the a2 relative cursor delta, and the count returned by MenuCursorNavigationHelper in the cursor-positioning path are inferred from usage only.
The a2 low-bit free semantics in the destructor family are inferred from the free(this) pattern and not independently confirmed.
